entity_raw.definition_raw:
You’re even harder to see when prone than most are.

Benefit(s): If you have been prone since the end of your last turn, the penalty on Perception checks for others to notice you increases by 1 for every 20 feet between you and the observer, to a maximum increase of 5 at 100 feet.

This stacks with the normal modifier for distance.
